# Social preview image

This file is a TODO marker. GitHub repos benefit from a custom 1200×630 social preview image (the image people see when the repo is shared on Twitter/X, Slack, etc.).

## How to add one

1. Create a 1200×630 PNG with:
   - Repo name: "Claude + Cursor Coordinator"
   - Tagline: "Drop-in coordination for Claude Code + Cursor"
   - Subtle visual element (maybe terminal output, .husky/ tree, or the workflow diagram)
   - Author credit at bottom: "by @aaron.armond"
   - Background: dark mode, matches GitHub aesthetic

2. Upload at: https://github.com/phileokairos-pixel/claude-cursor-coordinator/settings
   - Scroll to "Social preview"
   - Click "Edit"
   - Upload the PNG

## Tools

- [og-image.vercel.app](https://og-image.vercel.app/) — quick generator
- Figma / Canva — full custom design
- [shields.io social preview](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-tips-and-tricks) — text-based fallback

## Why this matters

When someone tweets the repo link, this is what shows up. Default GitHub preview shows just the repo name and description on a plain background — easy to scroll past. A custom image with the project's identity gets clicks.

Trade-off: 30 minutes of design work for permanently better link previews.
